extracted.name: Summer fruits & elderflower fool
extracted.description: Put a glut of summer fruits to delicious use in our glorious fool recipe. Fuss-free desserts like this are ideal for a dinner party or casual gathering
ingredient_lines: 400g mixed summer fruits (such as raspberries, blueberries, halved strawberries and redcurrants), any stems removed
instruction_lines: Tip all the fruit into a bowl, then sprinkle over the icing sugar, lemon juice and elderflower cordial. Stir and leave to macerate for 1 hr.

Whisk the double cream and vanilla extract, if using, to soft peaks using an electric whisk, then fold through the Greek yogurt and lemon zest. Gently fold three-quarters of the summer fruits through the cream mixture. Divide most of the remaining fruit between four dessert glasses, then spoon over the cream mixture and top with the rest of the fruit before serving. Will keep chilled overnight.
